name: Pangolin
overview: Reach private resources on a Pangolin network (e.g. an LDAPS server)
description: Connects Jellyfin to a Pangolin network as a machine client so the server can reach private resources, such as an LDAP server for the LDAP Authentication plugin. Userspace mode needs no root and forwards local ports; system mode runs the Pangolin CLI. Shows peer status and can test TCP/TLS reachability.

versions.changelog: New userspace mode, the default: runs the tunnel without root, NET_ADMIN or /dev/net/tun and forwards local ports to Pangolin resources, for managed hosts and unprivileged containers. System mode (the Pangolin CLI) is unchanged.
Explain up front when Jellyfin isn't running as root or sudo is missing (e.g. the linuxserver.io image) instead of failing or retrying.
